name: RC–B10–0156/2025 – After § 11 – Am 5
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on continuing the unwavering EU support for Ukraine, after three years of Russia’s war of aggression
part_text: 11a. Underlines that security guarantees for Ukraine and for Europe will be stronger under a renewed transatlantic cooperation and the traditional Western alliance; calls therefore for an urgent summit between the EU, the United States and all like-minded partners in order to relaunch and strengthen this crucial bond and verify the conditions for a just and lasting peace for Ukraine;
